records.text: Chanter skill points: Dark Crush first from Lv 4 and Onslaught early, then Spinning Strike, Recuperation, Incandescent Blow, Rushing Smash and Attack Preparation, all to 10 (Metabot, aion2turkiye, daevaguides; mmo-codex takes the first four to 8, then 10). Wind's Promise to 10 the day it is learned at 25 is two-source (aion2turkiye, daevaguides); Metabot's build leaves it out. Dark Crush first and Onslaught early are in all three ordering sources; the order after them is inferred.

First Daevanion nodes (Nezekan's Protection Circle and Attack Preparation pairs, then Zikel's Earth's Promise pair): Metabot's Chanter page and aion2turkiye, ordered by when the skills are learned; daevaguides takes the Dark Crush, Onslaught, Spinning Strike and Incandescent Blow nodes first.

Chanter learn levels (Impactful Crush 3, Dark Crush 4, Gust Rampage 5, Recuperation 8, Tremor Crush 10, Wave Blow 12, Spinning Strike 14 and the rest): your Chanter skill window, Metabot's skill pages (game data) and mmo-codex's unlock table.

Onslaught +20% MP restored and Incandescent Blow −20% MP consumed (daevaguides, mmo-codex; aion2turkiye takes other picks), and Rushing Smash's 50% Heat Wave Blow trigger (aion2turkiye, mmo-codex for farming; daevaguides says never take its other damage pick, mmo-codex takes that one for bosses).
The leveling loop: Impactful Crush or Spinning Strike opens Dark Crush for 2 s (Metabot's leveling build, mmo-codex, daevaguides, aion2turkiye; the window is the skills' text).

Impactful Crush to 8 (Metabot 10), Tremor Crush to 8 (aion2turkiye, daevaguides; Metabot 7) and Blessing of Life to 6 (Metabot 10): the guide takes the lower values with the last 35 points, which leaves room for Wind's Promise. Metabot's Inspiring Spell 5 is left out.

Specialty picks at skill Lv 8: Dark Crush Critical Hit on hit, Spinning Strike −5 s cooldown, Recuperation +1 consecutive use, Tremor Crush +10 m range, Impactful Crush as a mobile skill (mmo-codex, aion2turkiye, daevaguides).
Stat priority (HP, Attack, Defense): Metabot's Chanter page and class-builds guide (one site).

Stigmas Undefeated Mantra, Sprint Mantra, Power of the Storm, Marchutan's Wrath: the four are in every source and Undefeated Mantra first is confirmed. Slots 2–4 are Metabot's and aion2turkiye's order; daevaguides and mmo-codex put Power of the Storm second. Raised to 8 / 7 / 5 / 4: Metabot's.
Stigma slots 22 / 27 / 32 / 37; every stigma learnable at 22; shard cost per level (Metabot, allthings.how).
Dark Crush, Gust Rampage, Tremor Crush and Wave Blow fire only on their conditions (Metabot's skill pages, game data; mmo-codex, daevaguides).
